S&L Connect ist ein auf Agrartechnik sowie Rasen- und Grundstückspflege spezialisiertes Unternehmen und offizieller Partner von John Deere. Als verlässlicher Ansprechpartner stehen wir für landwirtschaftliche Produktivität sowie hochwertige Maschinen und Dienstleistungen.

Mit einem engagierten Team an zehn Standorten in Südbrandenburg und Sachsen bieten wir fortschrittliche Lösungen, die gezielt auf die vielfältigen Anforderungen von Landwirten und Grundstückseigentümern ausgerichtet sind. Unsere Mitarbeitenden, Kunden und Partner bilden dabei die Grundlage unseres nachhaltigen Erfolgs.
Aufgaben
In deiner Rolle als Recruiter (m/w/d) bist du für die Gewinnung neuer Mitarbeitender und Auszubildender an unseren Standorten in Brandenburg und Sachsen verantwortlich. Du begleitest den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess von der Bedarfsplanung bis zur erfolgreichen Einstellung und stehst unseren Führungskräften als kompetenter Ansprechpartner zur Seite.

Darüber hinaus betreust du unsere Auszubildenden während ihrer gesamten Ausbildungszeit und repräsentierst unser Unternehmen auf Messen und Recruiting-Veranstaltungen.
Die Position kann an unseren Standorten Großenhain oder Ostrau ausgeübt werden. Regelmäßige Dienstreisen zu unseren Standorten in Brandenburg und Sachsen gehören zu deinem Aufgabenbereich.

Beratung der Führungskräfte bei der Personalbedarfsplanung sowie Erstellung und Aktualisierung von Stellenbeschreibungen und Anforderungsprofilen
Steuerung des gesamten Recruiting-Prozesses von der Stellenausschreibung über die Bewerberauswahl bis zur Zu- oder Absage
Organisation und Begleitung von Telefon-/Teamsinterviews und Vorstellungsgesprächen an unseren Standorten
Weiterentwicklung unserer Recruiting-Kanäle sowie Zusammenarbeit mit Personalberatungen und Headhuntern bei Bedarf
Betreuung des gesamten Ausbildungsrecruitings von der Bewerbergewinnung bis zum Ausbildungsstart
Zentrale/r Ansprechpartner*in für unsere Auszubildenden, deren Eltern, Berufsschulen und Handwerkskammern in allen organisatorischen und personalrelevanten Themen während der Ausbildung
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Ausbildern und Führungskräften sowie Ansprechpartner*in für die Auszubildenden während ihrer gesamten Ausbildungszeit (die fachliche Ausbildung erfolgt durch die jeweiligen Ausbilder*in)
Organisation und Teilnahme an Ausbildungs-, Karriere- und Recruitingmessen sowie weiteren Maßnahmen des Ausbildungsmarketings
Erstellung von Recruiting-Kennzahlen und Unterstützung bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Arbeitgebermarke
Qualifikation
Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder ein Studium mit Schwerpunkt Personalmanagement, Wirtschaftspsychologie oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Recruiting oder Talent Acquisition
Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Führungskräften sowie in der eigenständigen Steuerung von Recruiting-Prozessen
Begeisterung für den Umgang mit Menschen sowie Interesse an der Betreuung und Entwicklung unserer Nachwuchskräfte
Sicherer Umgang in Microsoft 365 (insbesondere Outlook, Excel, Word und PowerPoint) sowie idealerweise Erfahrung mit Bewerbermanagement- oder HR-Systemen (Personio)
Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
Kommunikationsstärke, Organisationstalent und sicheres Auftreten
Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Dienstreisen innerhalb Brandenburgs und Sachsens
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1)
Gute Englischkenntnisse (B2)
Führerschein Klasse B

30 Urlaubstage und einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag
Flexible Arbeitszeiten im Rahmen eines Gleitzeitmodells
Individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und persönliche Entwicklungsperspektiven
Umweltfreundliches Pendeln durch die Möglichkeit des Bikeleasings
Eine verantwortungsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum und Raum für Eigeninitiative
Ein engagiertes Team, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt und gemeinsam viel bewegt
Ein monatliches Standortfrühstück zum persönlichen Austausch, inklusive unternehmerischem Update, damit du immer auf dem Laufenden bist
Exklusive Mitarbeiterangebote durch Corporate Benefits mit Rabatten und Sonderkonditionen bei zahlreichen Partnern
Du hast Freude daran, Menschen zusammenzubringen, Talente zu entdecken und unsere Standorte mit den richtigen Mitarbeitenden zu stärken? Gleichzeitig möchtest du unsere Auszubildenden auf ihrem Weg begleiten und unsere Arbeitgebermarke aktiv mitgestalten? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.
Bewirb dich jetzt unter Angabe deines möglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.
Herzliche Grüße
Franzisca & Juliane

Als vielseitiges Talent im Recruiting sicherst du das nachhaltige Wachstum unserer Teams und besetzt anspruchsvolle Positionen im IT-Bereich sowie im Projektmanagement und in unseren zentralen Business Functions. Du agierst als strategischer Partner für unsere Führungskräfte und begleitest Talente partnerschaftlich von der ersten Ansprache bis zu ihrem erfolgreichen Start. Die Stelle ist zum 01.10.2026 zu besetzen.
Aufgaben
End-to-End-Recruiting: Du steuerst den Recruiting-Prozess mit einem klaren Fokus (je nach deiner individuellen Vorerfahrung und Präferenz) entweder auf technisch anspruchsvolle IT-Rollen, Projektmanagement-Positionen oder zentrale Business Functions und sicherst eine erstklassige Candidate Experience.
Strategisches Stakeholder-Management: Du baust eine vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe mit unseren Führungskräften, Hiring Managern und HR-Partnern auf, um Bedarfe präzise zu definieren und Stellen erfolgreich zu besetzen.
Schnittstelle zu HR Operations: Du begleitest den Übergang vom Vertragsangebot zum nahtlosen Onboarding und arbeitest hierfür eng und partnerschaftlich mit unserem HR Operations Team zusammen.
Active Sourcing & Netzwerkarbeit: Bei Bedarf identifizierst und kontaktierst du passende Talente proaktiv über relevante Plattformen und baust dir ein nachhaltiges Netzwerk in den Communities auf.
Prozessoptimierung & Innovation: Du unterstützt aktiv bei der Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung unserer Recruiting-Prozesse und treibst die Nutzung moderner KI-Tools zur Effizienzsteigerung im täglichen Workflow voran.
Employer Branding & Kampagnengestaltung: Du bringst dich aktiv in die Stärkung unserer Arbeitgebermarke ein und konzipierst und gestaltest zielgruppenspezifische Recruiting-Kampagnen, um Talente gezielt anzusprechen.
Qualifikation
Relevante Berufserfahrung: Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung im Recruiting, entweder in einer Inhouse-Rolle oder auf Personaldienstleister- bzw. Agenturseite.
Expertise in modernen Tools & KI: Praktische Erfahrung in der Nutzung innovativer Recruiting-Technologien sowie der gezielten Anwendung von KI-Tools zur Optimierung deiner täglichen Arbeitsabläufe.
Gespür für HR-Trends: Du hast ein gutes Gespür für digitale HR-Trends und Freude daran, neue Impulse eigenständig umzusetzen.
Erste Erfahrung im Employer Branding: Erste praktische Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Umsetzung von zielgruppenspezifischen Kampagnen und Maßnahmen zur zielgruppengerechten Arbeitgeberpositionierung.
Kommunikationsstärke: Du kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch und fließend auf Englisch, um dich in unserem globalen JAKALA-Netzwerk erfolgreich zu bewegen.

Flexible Arbeitszeiten (nach Absprache) in unserem Hamburger oder Berliner Büro / hybrid.
Verantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum im Kontext eines internationalen Unternehmens.
Unterstützung bei deiner Mobilität (Deutschlandticket), Gesundheit (Urban Sports Club) und nachhaltigen Arbeitsweisen (Bikeleasing).
Regelmäßige Team-Formate wie gemeinsames Frühstück/Lunch, bei denen Austausch und Zusammenarbeit im Mittelpunkt stehen.
Wenn du willst: Einstieg in unsere Hamburger Band (Schlagzeuger:in gesucht).
JAKALA ist ein weltweit tätiges IT- und Consulting-Unternehmen im Bereich MarTech, mit einem starken Fokus auf Daten und KI. Von den weltweit über 3.400 Mitarbeitenden sind rund 230 in der DACH-Region tätig.

Bei JAKALA Germany liegt der Schwerpunkt auf der Entwicklung von individuellen Software-Lösungen, hauptsächlich von sogenannten Digital Experience Platforms (DXP), in denen Geschäftsprozesse entlang der Customer Journey digitalisiert werden.

An der Schnittstelle von Strategie, Design und Technologie entwickelt JAKALA digitale Plattformen, Apps und andere Services, welche die digitalen Erlebnisse großer Marken maßgeblich prägen. Zu den Kunden in Deutschland zählen beispielsweise TUI Cruises, Leica, die Hamburger Hochbahn oder das ZDF.
Wir sind überzeugt: Vielfalt macht uns besser. Deshalb freuen wir uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen aller Hintergründe - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, Religion, sexueller Orientierung, Behinderung, Identität oder anderen gesetzlich geschützten Merkmalen.

Offene Stellen mit perfekten Kandidaten besetzen

Personalentwicklung

Fähigkeit, effektiv unter Druck zu arbeiten und Prioritäten zu setzen.

Suite, etc.).

Job Title: Sr Recruiter - FSP Job Location: Bangalore, Karnātaka, India Job Location Type: Remote Job Contract Type: Full time Job Seniority Level: Environmental Conditions: Office Work Schedule: Standard (Mon-Fri) Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Office Job Description As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale.

Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer.

We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

DESCRIPTION: Join our Talent Acquisition team at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where you'll contribute to attracting qualified talent to help advance our mission of making the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. As a Sr Recruiter , you'll serve as a strategic talent advisor, managing full-cycle recruitment for diverse roles across business units.

You'll collaborate with hiring managers and HR teams to develop effective sourcing strategies, build strong talent pipelines, and deliver an outstanding candidate experience.

This role offers the opportunity to shape our talent strategy while representing our culture of integrity, intensity, innovation, and involvement.  Sources, recruits, screens resumes and interviews internal and external candidates for vacancies including mid to executive level positions.  Ensures necessary authorization is obtained prior to commencing recruitment activity.  Maintains records of activity via the recruitment system and prepares productivity, analytical and other reports as assigned.

Tracks applicants.  May assist management in sourcing of support functions as necessary.

Manages workflow within the team, communicates corporate initiatives, strategies and measurements, trains and develops existing recruiters.  Provides frequent, high quality, value-added advice and counsel to business partners on recruiting and staffing issues.  Remains abreast of industry trends.  Provides relevant reports for Hiring Managers for added value or influence.  May provide leadership, direction, mentoring, training, and/or coaching for junior team members.

REQUIREMENTS: Bachelor's degree required. Additional professional certifications in HR or recruitment considered as a plus 6+ Years of experience in End to End Recruitment cycle .

Clinical research/CRO industry experience preferred Should have experience in Managing Global Internal and External Stakeholders Should be able act as seasoned, experienced professional with a full understanding of area of specialization; resolves a wide range of issues in creative ways.

Should have experience in representing the department as a prime contact on projects.

Experience using Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and CRM systems, with Workday knowledge preferred Strong expertise in sourcing strategies including Boolean search, direct sourcing, and social media recruiting Demonstrated ability to manage high-volume recruitment across multiple business functions Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office suite, especially Excel and PowerPoint for metrics and presentations Excellent stakeholder management and consultation skills at all organizational levels Strong data analysis and reporting capabilities to drive insights and decision-making Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; fluency in English required Additional language skills beneficial (e.g., German, French, Spanish, Mandarin) Proven track record of building relationships and influencing through collaboration Experience with metrics tracking, dashboard creation, and data-driven recruiting insights Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively Strong project management and process improvement capabilities Experience representing company at recruitment events and career fairs Knowledge of employment laws and compliance requirements This job is curated by Lifelancer .

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale.

More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box.

Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency.

Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.
Company Operating Rhythm
At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.
Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.
Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.
The Opportunity
As a Senior Technical Recruiter, you'll own full-cycle recruiting for our most complex and high-impact engineering roles — spanning customer-facing and core platform teams — across both US and international markets. You'll help Deepgram scale by building pipelines for AI-native technical talent across geographies, navigating regional market dynamics, and partnering closely with the team on compliant, scalable hiring practices.
This role requires fluency in how AI products are built and deployed, strong judgment on technical bar, and a systems-level view of recruiting — not just within one market, but across time zones, cultures, and the specialized talent communities that define the frontier of voice AI and applied machine learning.

Own full-cycle recruiting for senior and hard-to-fill technical roles across Research, Engineering, and Product teams.
Lead global recruiting efforts across multiple regions (e.g. US, EMEA, APAC), including sourcing, interviewing, and closing candidates in diverse markets.
Partner with hiring managers to define role scope, leveling, and interview plans that account for both business needs and regional talent realities.
Build proactive sourcing strategies for niche and senior-level technical talent in the US and abroad.
Evaluate candidates for technical depth, impact, and alignment with Deepgram’s values across different cultural and regional contexts.
Deliver a high-quality candidate experience across time zones through clear communication, thoughtful process design, and operational rigor.
Use data and funnel metrics to diagnose issues, improve signal quality, and increase hiring velocity globally.
Collaborate with People Ops, Legal, and Finance to support compliant global hiring (employment models, offers, and regional considerations).
Help evolve recruiting infrastructure, tools, and interview practices to support international scale.

Hands-on experience leading global expansion efforts, including hiring across multiple countries or regions.
Experience recruiting for at least two of the following domains: Customer Engineering / Solutions Engineering, Backend / Platform Infrastructure, Product Engineering, or Developer-facing roles.
Strong technical literacy — you don't need to code, but you should understand how modern software systems, APIs, and customer-integrated technical products are built. We are an AI-native company and believe in the future of these products.
Proven ability to source and close senior-level and highly specialized technical talent in competitive, international markets, particularly for roles that sit at the intersection of technical depth and customer impact.
Comfort operating in ambiguity and helping teams sharpen what "good" looks like across different regions and customer segments.
Excellent stakeholder management skills and the confidence to push back when needed — especially when balancing speed-to-hire with bar integrity for customer-critical roles.
A builder's mindset: you care about process quality, signal, and long-term scalability, not just filling seats.

Experience recruiting for AI-native, AI-first, or applied AI companies
Deep familiarity with AI/ML systems, LLMs, real-time inference, or data-intensive infrastructure — enough to hold a credible conversation with the engineers you're hiring.
Experience supporting distributed, remote-first teams building AI products across time zones and geographies.

About SpartanX LLC At SpartanX , our approach is straightforward: we pair top-of-the-line solar technology with unmatched value. We deliver reliable solutions for homeowners while empowering our teams to grow, lead, and make a lasting impact. To be a Spartan means to lead with purpose, embrace challenges, and create meaningful change.

Our mission is driven by innovation, integrity, and a commitment to excellence in solar energy. Join our community of professionals shaping the future of clean energy, where every project reflects our promise of Solar Done Right.

Bilingual Recruiter (English/Spanish) Fully Remote | $55,000–$60,000 per year SpartanX is looking for a Bilingual Recruiter who knows how to find exceptional talent in the electrical and construction industries.

If you have experience recruiting electricians, construction professionals, or skilled trades—and solar recruiting is in your toolbox—we want to talk to you. This is a fully remote position supporting hiring efforts across multiple U.S. markets.

You'll partner with hiring managers to recruit top talent while helping build the workforce that powers one of the fastest-growing industries in the country.

What You'll Do Recruit electricians, apprentices, construction professionals, and skilled trades talent Source candidates using Indeed, LinkedIn, referrals, social media, and networking Conduct phone screens and virtual interviews in both English and Spanish Manage multiple open requisitions while maintaining an exceptional candidate experience Build and maintain talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs Partner with hiring managers to understand staffing priorities Maintain accurate applicant tracking records and recruiting metrics Extend offers and coordinate with the HR and onboarding teams What We're Looking For Fluent in English and Spanish (written and verbal) Previous recruiting experience in electrical, construction, or skilled trades Solar industry recruiting experience is a strong plus Experience managing full-cycle recruiting Strong sourcing and interviewing skills Ability to prioritize multiple positions and meet hiring deadlines Experience using ATS platforms and major job boards Excellent communication and relationship-building skills Self-motivated with the ability to work independently in a remote environment What We Offer $55,000–$60,000 annual salary Fully remote position Monday–Friday schedule Opportunity to recruit for a growing national company Supportive, collaborative team environment Opportunities for career growth and advancement If you're a recruiter who understands the skilled trades, enjoys finding hard-to-fill talent, and thrives in a fast-paced environment, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and help us build the teams that keep SpartanX growing. Solar Done Right. Legal Disclaimer SpartanX is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values workplace diversity.

Manage the full recruitment lifecycle; from initial briefing and headhunting to negotiation and onboarding.
Build a robust pipeline of technical experts across South Africa, the UK, Mauritius, and beyond.
Rapidly source and deploy contractors for project-based team augmentation.
Act as a strategic advisor to hiring managers, defining job specs and providing market-realistic salary benchmarks.

5+ years in technical recruitment, ideally with a blend of agency speed and in-house culture.

A deep understanding of the South African market and global regions, including compliance, notice periods, and salary expectations.
You have an existing, active network of technical professionals and contractors ready to go.

Your DNA

You won't work in a vacuum; you’ll be an engaged collaborator working alongside an existing team of Delivery Capability Leads and Executive Heads
Enjoy your special day with your birthday off and a work culture that prizes agility and professional integrity.
Take responsibility for a global talent pool, giving you exposure to international hiring nuances and compliance.
Ready to power our technical projects with the world's best talent? Apply now! Originally posted on Himalayas

About BJAK
The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.
Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.
We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

We are looking for a Senior Recruiter (Corporate Functions) to lead hiring across Operations, Finance, Marketing, Creative, HR, Legal, Strategy, CEO Office, and other corporate functions globally.
This role combines hands-on recruitment execution with leadership responsibilities. You will partner closely with business leaders to attract high-impact talent, drive hiring strategy, and help build a scalable Talent Acquisition function capable of supporting BJAK’s rapid global growth.
You will play a critical role in shaping the organization by hiring exceptional talent while mentoring junior recruiters and establishing recruiting best practices across the business.

Business Recruitment Leadership
Own the end-to-end recruitment process for business and corporate functions globally, including Operations, Finance, Marketing, Creative, HR, Legal, CEO Office, and other key functions.
Partner closely with hiring managers and senior leaders to define hiring priorities, organizational needs, role requirements, and workforce planning strategies.
Act as a trusted talent advisor by providing market intelligence, compensation insights, hiring recommendations, and talent market trends.
Lead recruitment efforts for senior, niche, confidential, and business-critical positions across multiple regions.
Develop and execute creative sourcing strategies to attract high-caliber passive candidates in competitive talent markets.
Talent Pipeline & Market Intelligence
Build and maintain strong talent pipelines across key business functions to support both current and future hiring needs.
Conduct talent mapping exercises across target companies, industries, and markets.
Develop strong understanding of global labor markets, compensation trends, and talent availability across multiple countries.
Team Development & Process Excellence
Mentor and support junior recruiters, helping improve sourcing effectiveness, candidate assessment quality, and stakeholder management capabilities.
Establish recruiting best practices, interview calibration standards, sourcing frameworks, and hiring processes across business functions.
Review recruitment performance, pipeline quality, and hiring outcomes to identify opportunities for improvement.
Support the development and scaling of the global Talent Acquisition team.
Recruitment Operations & Reporting
Maintain accurate ATS data, candidate records, and recruitment reporting.
Track recruitment metrics including pipeline health, time-to-hire, source effectiveness, offer acceptance rates, and hiring quality.
Ensure a professional, positive, and consistent candidate experience across all recruitment stages.
Support compliance with local labor regulations and recruitment best practices across multiple regions.
The Right Fit Has

As we prepare to scale and launch in the US, you will bring immediate senior hiring capacity into Odin to close the priority leadership and high-impact roles for Q3 and Q4.

Talent partner
Hybrid role to be based in our Holborn, London or George Street, Edinburgh office.

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.
We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe.
We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.
We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.
If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.
Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

We’re looking for a talent partner to join our People team, reporting to our talent lead. We have an ambitious hiring plan and need an experienced recruiter who can help us bring great people into Seccl at pace.
This is a hands-on delivery role. You’ll primarily support our Product and Engineering teams, owning roles from intake and sourcing through to interview, offer and close. Product and Engineering will be your core focus, but you’ll also pick up hiring across other teams as our priorities change.
You’ll build trusted relationships with hiring managers and bring clear advice, market insight and constructive challenge. You’ll help teams make strong decisions and keep hiring moving, while recognising that hiring managers remain accountable for the final call.
Things move quickly here and plans change. You’ll need to be comfortable working with ambiguity, adapting your approach and switching focus without losing momentum. You’ll care about a high hiring bar and a brilliant candidate experience, while staying pragmatic about how we get there.
What you’ll own
Delivering end-to-end hiring across a portfolio of roles, primarily within Product and Engineering, while flexing across Seccl when priorities change to support with non-Technical roles
Building strong candidate pipelines through direct sourcing, agency management, creative search approaches and thoughtful engagement
Creating pace across every hiring process, spotting blockers early and keeping candidates and hiring teams moving
Partnering with hiring managers and leaders to clarify what they need, share market insight and support strong, evidence-based decisions
Maintaining a high hiring bar and an inclusive, engaging experience without adding unnecessary process or complexity
Using hiring data and day-to-day insight to improve delivery, sharing practical ideas with the talent lead and wider People team
This role’s for you if...
You have strong experience owning and delivering end-to-end recruitment across multiple live roles in a fast moving, scaling business
You bring genuine expertise in Product and Engineering hiring, with the technical understanding and market knowledge to work credibly with hiring teams
You’re a confident direct sourcer who knows how to find, engage and build relationships with strong candidates
You’re highly delivery-focused, organised and proactive, and you naturally create momentum without needing lots of direction
You’re comfortable with ambiguity and incomplete information, and can change direction quickly when business priorities shift
You can challenge constructively, stay pragmatic and judge when to advise, when to push and when to help a hiring manager move forward
You’re happy to recruit outside your core specialism when needed. Experience in a fast-paced or scale-up environment would be valuable
This role isn’t for you if...
You’re looking for a mainly strategic or project-based role. Most of your time will be spent actively delivering hiring and owning live roles
You need priorities and processes to stay fixed. Our needs can change quickly, so you’ll need to adapt and make sensible calls without perfect information
You prefer to stay within one recruitment specialism. Product and Engineering will be your focus, but you’ll pick up roles across Seccl when needed
You see partnership as owning the final hiring decision. We want you to bring expertise and challenge, while enabling hiring managers to make the call and keep things moving
You rely mainly on inbound applications or agencies. Direct sourcing and proactive pipeline building are important parts of this role
What’s in it for you
We offer a generous mix of benefits designed around the things that matter to our people:
💰 A salary between £55,000 and £65,000 , reviewed annually, plus a 6% employer pension contribution and life assurance
🌴 27 days’ holiday plus bank holidays , your birthday off and paid dependant leave
💙 Two volunteering days each year
🌎 The option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year
🌟 Secclbrate , our recognition programme offering flexible rewards including extra pay, additional holiday and increased learning budget
🏅 One-month paid sabbatical after eight years
🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health
👪 Enhanced parental leave
💻 MacBook and up to £500 towards your home office set-up
📖 £750 annual learning budget
🌻 Health and wellbeing support , including free therapy through Wellness Cloud and mental health support through Headspace
🌱 Financial wellbeing benefits , including Octopus Money, the Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing through Octopus Legacy
🎁 Perkbox , with flexible points and a range of discounts and perks
🚲 Access to Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing

We put people first and try hard to create an environment where people feel trusted, heard and able to do their best work.
We value openness, curiosity and different perspectives. You’ll have the freedom to challenge how things are done, experiment with better ways of working and take real ownership of your impact.
Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

Interviewing is a two-way process. Our interviews are conversational, with plenty of time for you to get to know us and ask questions too.
First stage - competencies based interview with the talent lead
Second stage - interview with the head of people and talent lead to delve into your technical skills (this may include a case study or live interview task)
Final stage - 45 mins bar-raiser culture-based interview with two key stakeholders for this role
We review applications as they come in and may close the role once we have enough candidates to move forward. We’ll keep you updated throughout.

Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance?
Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist.
We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world.
We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them.

The AI Startups and scaleups we work with have roles they can't fill. Not because they haven't tried, but because they have world-class hiring bars, and it’s genuinely tough.
As a Talent Partner looking after our clients, you own those relationships. You take a role briefing properly, you push back when it doesn't add up, and you become the person a founder, internal talent partner or hiring manager calls before they've even decided to hire. You will also own delivery: ensuring that our clients receive an amazing experience using Dex.
You'll also be a power user of our product. We use Dex on our own hiring every day, and the feedback loop between you and the people building it should be strong.

Own a portfolio of client relationships end to end; brief, delivery, feedback, and everything after
Take role briefs / kick-offs that actually hold up. Scope the role, interrogate the requirements, and tell a client when the role is really two roles, or shouldn't be hired at all
Run the process on the client side: keep feedback fast, keep interviews moving, keep momentum from breaking
Analyse their Dex pipelines with conviction and manage expectations so offers land
Negotiate offers with the client. Get people over the line without either side feeling managed
Grow accounts. Turn a single search into a relationship; more roles, more trust, more of the hiring plan
Be the client's most useful call of the week; delivering market insights, clear pipeline reporting, honest candidate reads, and effective advice

Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results.
The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic.
Read this part first
Somewhere out there is a sourcer who is better than their job title says they are. They hit their numbers at a company that never let them talk to a hiring manager. They found the candidate nobody else found and watched a recruiter take the credit. They have been told to be patient, to wait for the next cycle, to earn it.
We are not going to make you wait.
What we do
We build autonomous aircraft and Legion, the software that flies hundreds of them as one coordinated swarm. Series A, backed by Khosla Ventures, and Coatue. We are hiring software engineers and aircraft engineers at the same time, which is hard, and how fast we hire is one of the few things standing between the current aircraft and the next one.
That is not a motivational line. It is the actual constraint. Recruiting is on the critical path here, and you will be able to see your work in the flight schedule.
The job
You own top of funnel for our software engineering roles: backend, frontend, autonomy, forward deployed. You will be reading GitHub profiles, writing outreach that engineers answer, and building searches that keep producing after the obvious names are gone.
Then the interesting part. Inside your first year you move onto the aircraft side: propulsion, structures, avionics, manufacturing, production. Almost nobody sources both. The people who can are rare enough that it changes what your career looks like from that point forward. We will teach you, and you will be bad at it for a while, and then you will not be.
What you get here that you did not get there
Your own reqs, early, with your name on the outcome
Hiring managers in the same building, not behind an intake form
The freedom to change the message when it is not working, without asking three people first
Someone who runs sourcing searches themselves every day and will look at your search strings with you
A skill set at the end of two years that maybe a few hundred people in the country have
What we need from you
1+ years of sourcing or recruiting, most of it in software engineering
A hire you are proud of, one nobody else was going to find, and the ability to walk us through exactly how you found them
A high tolerance for silence, because most of your outreach will go unanswered and the job is making the next message better anyway
Real curiosity about how aircraft get built, or at least the honesty to say you find it interesting and want in
Writing that sounds like a person, since your entire work product is text a stranger decides to open or delete
Clean data habits, because our reporting goes to the CEO and it needs to be right
What we do not need
Ten years of experience. A recruiting pedigree. A degree in anything specific. Permission from your current manager to be good at this.
The honest version
The pace is uncomfortable. You will be asked to fill roles you do not understand yet, and the answer will usually be to go learn them rather than to wait for a briefing.
If you want a clear ladder and a quiet quarter, this is the wrong job. If you have been waiting for someone to hand you something real, this is the shot.
